This is anomalous compared to other settings backends (like NVS or file), which do not have such a declaration. While the exact reason this declaration interferes with the Kconfig resolution is complex and likely related to build system internals, its removal aligns `settings_fcb.c` with the structure of other backends and resolves the configuration problem.

The fix is to remove the unnecessary forward declaration.
